description: Your app reports errors; Claude Code, Cursor or any MCP client reads the stack trace, fixes it and marks it resolved.

interface.shortDescription: Production errors your coding agent can read and resolve
interface.longDescription: Runheed is error tracking your coding agent can read. Your app reports exceptions through a Node or Python SDK; Codex connects to https://runheed.com/api/mcp, reads each error with its stack trace and breadcrumbs, fixes the code and resolves the error with a note naming the commit. Sign in once with OAuth. Plans from $29 a month with a 7-day trial.
defaultPrompt: What errors happened since the last deploy?
Fix the top production error and resolve it
